newsitem.title: USA: Butler National unit gains AirNet order.
newsitem.headline: Butler National unit gains AirNet order.

text.p: Butler National Corp said Tuesday its Avcon Industries Inc subsidiary received an order to modify the aircraft fleet of AirNet Systems Inc. It said all the modifications are expected to exceed $2.5 million.
AirNet operates more than 80 aircraft, which fly about 85,000 miles per night. The company transports canceled checks and related information for the U.S. banking industry.
Phase One of the project is valued in excess of $500,000.
Butler operates in the aerospace and services business segments.
